name: Woodridge
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Woodridge, IL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Woodridge, IL: Winterfest at Kagann Plaza, Brunch with Santa at Seven Bridges, Nutcracker on Ice, an Elf movie night and trains nearby.
lede: Woodridge opens its holiday season with Winterfest, a free tree lighting at Village Hall and Kagann Plaza, then keeps the season going with a Santa brunch, a Nutcracker on ice and holiday programs at the park district and library.
celebrates: Woodridge celebrates as a team. Winterfest is hosted by the Village of Woodridge, the Woodridge Park District, the Woodridge Public Library, the Woodridge Special Events Committee and the Woodridge Volunteer Corps at Village Hall, 5 Plaza Drive. Families get a 20 foot tree lighting in Kagann Plaza, photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus inside Village Hall, live reindeer, a makers market, food trucks and festive trolley rides from Cypress Cove. In December the library hides Larry the Library Elf and hosts Jefferson Junior High carolers, the park district plans Santa crafts and a holiday movie night, Seven Bridges Golf Club serves Brunch with Santa, and Creative Ice Theatre skates Nutcracker on Ice at Seven Bridges Ice Arena.
lastyear: For 2025, the Woodridge Park District and Patch listed Woodridge Winterfest for Saturday, November 22, from 3 to 7 pm at Kagann Plaza. It was planned with Santa and Mrs. Claus, 25 makers market vendors in a heated tent, food trucks, a children's craft area, and Anna, Elsa and Rudolph, plus a holiday trolley from Cypress Cove. Patch later listed Santa's Bedtime Stories at the Fred C. Hohnke Community Center on December 14, and Arts DuPage listed Nutcracker on Ice at Seven Bridges Ice Arena for December 13 and 14.
facts: Santa Comes to Woodridge is one of the village's longest running traditions. In 2015 Patch called it the 46th annual event, hosted by the Woodridge Special Events Committee at the St. Scholastica Parish Activity Center on Janes Avenue, where Santa and Mrs. Claus arrived on a fire truck and every child received a free gift. In 2024 the visit moved inside Village Hall as part of Winterfest, where children could also drop off letters to Santa and the first 500 visitors at Lola's Churros got free hot chocolate.
trains: Neighboring Lisle has a Metra station at 1000 Front Street on the BNSF line, with ticket vending machines and more than 800 parking spaces. Metra runs specially decorated Holiday Trains with holiday characters on the BNSF line each December, so check metra.com/holidaytrains for the schedule. At Winterfest, festive trolleys shuttle families from Cypress Cove Family Aquatic Park to the party and back. For a ride with Santa, the Illinois Railway Museum in Union runs a holiday train, and the Fox River Trolley Museum in South Elgin runs Santa's Trolley Express.
train_links: The largest railway museum in the US, with holiday train rides each season.
Historic trolley rides along the Fox River in South Elgin, plus Santa's Trolley Express.
traditions: A free tree lighting and holiday party at Village Hall and Kagann Plaza, hosted by the village, park district, library and volunteers.
The Woodridge Special Events Committee's Santa visit, now held inside Village Hall during Winterfest.
Each day in December the Woodridge Public Library's elf sits in a new spot with a new book, and finders win a sticker.
Brunch with Santa at Seven Bridges
Seven Bridges Golf Club serves a holiday buffet with Santa visits and photos.
Creative Ice Theatre tells The Nutcracker on skates at Seven Bridges Ice Arena each December.
The Woodridge Human Relations Advisory Committee collects nonperishable food at Village Hall, the library and the ARC around Winterfest.
kidfact: Santa used to arrive in Woodridge on a fire truck. Today, at Winterfest, all children are invited to the front of the tree in Kagann Plaza to help the mayor light it up.
faq: Winterfest is held on a Saturday in late November, the weekend before Thanksgiving in recent years: November 23, 2024, and November 22, 2025. It takes place at Village Hall and Kagann Plaza, 5 Plaza Drive, and it is free. Check the Village of Woodridge or Woodridge Park District event pages for each year's schedule of Santa photos, reindeer and the tree lighting.
Where do I park for Woodridge Winterfest?

Recent schedules sent drivers to the Fred C. Hohnke Community Center at 2600 Center Drive and Thomas Jefferson Junior High at 7200 Janes Avenue, with the Town Centre lot kept for vendors, staff and handicap parking. Families can also park at Cypress Cove Family Aquatic Park, 8301 Janes Avenue, and ride a festive holiday trolley to the event and back.
Where can kids see Santa in Woodridge?

Santa and Mrs. Claus pose for photos inside Village Hall during Winterfest, a tradition of the Woodridge Special Events Committee. In December, Seven Bridges Golf Club hosts Brunch with Santa with photos, and the Woodridge Park District has held Santa story and craft nights at the Fred C. Hohnke Community Center, and this season's sessions filled up early.
Is there a Nutcracker in Woodridge?

Yes, on ice. Creative Ice Theatre presents Nutcracker on Ice at Seven Bridges Ice Arena on Route 53, telling the whole story on skates to Tchaikovsky's music with more than one hundred skaters. It runs for one weekend in December with reserved seating, and all ages are welcome.
Can I bring my dog or a stroller to Winterfest?

Strollers and wagons are welcome throughout Winterfest, indoors and outdoors, but pets are not permitted. Outside food and drinks are not allowed either, since food trucks sell meals on site, and the event is alcohol free. A heated dining tent on the south end of the parking lot gives families a warm place to eat.
